goal: Build a reusable mechanical digital-asset compiler that understands object role, measures reference evidence, generates readable native rules, compiles materials, and verifies the result without retaining the source mesh as the product asset.
selectedDefaultStack: Trimesh + NumPy/SciPy for reference intake and section semantics
VTK for repeated background cutting and surface-distance maps
CadQuery/OCP for accepted B-Rep primitive and constraint compilation
Three.js + size-gated three-mesh-bvh for browser spatial queries
COLMAP only for overlapping multi-view photo reconstruction
Open3D only when point clouds/scans require registration
SurfaceProgram with OpenPBR-aligned semantics and later MaterialX interchange
Headless Blender as optional independent referee
nextExperiment: MeasurementKernel R01: reference/native BVHs, named anchor planes, 64-128 normalized cross sections, section-envelope differences, candidate primitive fits with confidence, receiver and barrel exterior continuity first.
